notes: Names printed without a suffix (HOPPLE, GILMORE, FOULKE, PROBASCO) are written with 'Street'; 'RIDDLE R'D' is written 'Riddle Road'; 'STIER ALLEY' (10') is the alley running SSE from Hopple. Hopple (50') comes in at the top left and ends at West McMicken (T; McMicken's east line is continuous). Gilmore (60' printed at the top left) runs along the canal's east bank, which is its west line; Gilmore/Hopple lies west of the left edge (on 289) and is not recorded here. Stier Alley ends at a 12 ft passage (printed 12') that runs WSW from Stier's south end to Gilmore; recorded as an unnamed alley, its Gilmore end taken on Gilmore's centreline. West McMicken flares at the Riddle Road fork (Y junction; the T point is where the two water pipes meet). Riddle Road (60') loops NE, E and S around block 1 and leaves the right edge into the binding just above Deckebach Avenue: the Riddle/Deckebach junction centre is beyond the gutter (Deckebach's west line runs down x~6340 from 6340,4600, its centre is past x~6480) and is left for sheet 284. Foulke Street (~27 ft as drawn, no width printed) runs east from Riddle Road's south leg off the right edge. Deckebach runs down the right edge in the gutter (west line x~6270-6340); its crossing with Probasco is beyond the gutter here and is picked on 276. Probasco (50') runs from the right edge west to the McMicken lot line at x~5245, where it ends. All other lines in blocks 1, 2 and 3 are lot lines.
